content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for missing prior authorization based on the documented clinical indication. The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities."}
